A word or phrase used to refer to the second person informal “tú” by their conjugation or implied context (e.g., How are you?).(informal) (imperative; second person singular)a. shut up ¡Cállate la boca! Estoy tratando de concentrarme.Shut up! I'm trying to focus.b. keep your mouth shut ¡Cállate la boca! No quiero escuchar más mentiras.Keep your mouth shut!
